verdict.rationale: Shopify's docs say Tap to Pay turns a smartphone into a checkout that accepts contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay and other digital wallets, so the contactless and mobile-wallet parts of the story are covered. Nothing in the pack documents chip (EMV) card acceptance, and an old community comment says the product still needed chip support. That comment is not a dispute, since the docs never claim chip support, but it leaves a third of the story unproven. Missing for 10: documented chip/EMV card-reader support, hands-on or independent corroboration of in-person payment acceptance.
